en-US.title: JunctionShare
en-US.subtitle: PJ last-mile carpool
en-US.description:
JunctionShare helps people around Princeton Junction and West Windsor share last-mile rides.

Need a ride or have seats? Broadcast a short request with your destination, how far you’re willing to match (about 100m–1km), and a time window. People near you with the opposite request can see it, and you can see theirs. Continue the conversation on WhatsApp when you’re ready to go.

Built for the train-to-home stretch: simple, local, and designed so you stay in control of who you contact. Requests expire when their time window ends.

Location is used to match nearby requests, including in the background while a request is active if you allow it. Your WhatsApp number is shared only after you both tap Interested.
en-US.promoText: Find a nearby ride or empty seat after the train — then continue on WhatsApp.

review.notes: JunctionShare is a last-mile carpool helper for the Princeton Junction / West Windsor area. Live matching: two phones near each other, each with a saved first name and WhatsApp number, broadcast opposite roles (Need a ride and Have seats) and then see each other under Nearby. One phone alone shows an empty inbox. Flow: Home → Need a ride → pick a destination → Broadcast. The app asks for location While Using, then Always. Always updates location only while a request is active so nearby people can still see it in the background; denying it does not block Home or Profile, and Settings is offered. Profile has a Save button for name and WhatsApp number. The app does not read contacts. No paid features. Export compliance: standard encryption only (ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = false).
